messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "talk to your healthcare provider about how you can take part in this registry"
set: ["talk to your healthcare provider about how you can take part in this registry", "talk with your doctor about this risk", "talk with your healthcare provider about the benefits of breastfeeding alongside your need for this medicine", "call your healthcare provider if this happens", "healthcare provider can discuss registering with National Pregnancy Registry for Antidepressants", "talk to your doctor if this occurs", "take exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider", "talk to healthcare provider if breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed", "talk to healthcare provider if become pregnant during treatment", "part of this shell may appear in your stool", "ask healthcare provider about joining national pregnancy registry for antidepressants if pregnant", "inform healthcare provider about Asian descent", "inform healthcare provider about liver problems", "inform healthcare provider about kidney problems", "inform healthcare provider about thyroid problems", "talk to healthcare provider if pregnant or plan to become pregnant"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
